it/vim-cheatsheet.vim file.txt\nvim +100 file.txt -- 跳到 1:
vim file.txt
vim +100 file.txt  -- jump to line 100
vim -R file.txt  -- read-only
it/vim-cheatsheet.默认模式，按 Esc 进入: Default mode, press Esc to enter it
it/vim-cheatsheet.i 光标前插入\na 光标后插入\nI 行首插入\nA 行末插入\no:
i  insert before the cursor
a  insert after the cursor
I  insert at line start
A  insert at line end
o  new line below
O  new line above
it/vim-cheatsheet.v 字符选择\nV 行选择\nCtrl+v 块选择:
v  select characters
V  select lines
Ctrl+v  select a block
it/vim-cheatsheet.:w 保存\n:q 退出\n:wq 保存退出\n:q! 强制退出:
:w  save
:q  quit
:wq  save and quit
:q!  quit without saving
it/vim-cheatsheet.:w\n:q\n:wq\n:q! -- 不保存退出\n:x -- 保存退出\:
:w
:q
:wq
:q!  -- quit without saving
:x  -- save and quit
ZZ  -- same as :x
ZQ  -- same as :q!
it/vim-cheatsheet.:r other.txt -- 插入文件内容\n:r! date -- 插入:
:r other.txt  -- insert the file content
:r! date  -- insert command output
it/vim-cheatsheet.h 左\nj 下\nk 上\nl 右:
h left
j down
k up
l right
it/vim-cheatsheet.W B 跳空白分隔: W B move by whitespace-separated words
it/vim-cheatsheet.w 下个单词开头\nb 上个单词开头\ne 下个单词末尾:
w  start of the next word
b  start of the previous word
e  end of the next word
it/vim-cheatsheet.行首/首个非空/行末: Line start / first non-blank / line end
it/vim-cheatsheet.0 行首\n^ 首个非空字符\n$ 行末:
0  line start
^  first non-blank character
$  line end
it/vim-cheatsheet.gg 文件首\nG 文件末\n100G 跳到 100 行:
gg  start of the file
G  end of the file
100G  jump to line 100
it/vim-cheatsheet.Ctrl+u 上半屏\nCtrl+d 下半屏:
Ctrl+u  up half a screen
Ctrl+d  down half a screen
it/vim-cheatsheet.Ctrl+f 下一页\nCtrl+b 上一页:
Ctrl+f  page down
Ctrl+b  page up
it/vim-cheatsheet.光标在 ( 上按 % 跳到匹配的 ): With the cursor on (, press % to jump to the matching )
it/vim-cheatsheet.搜光标下单词 下/上: Search the word under the cursor, forward / backward
it/vim-cheatsheet./function\nn 下一个匹配\nN 上一个匹配:
/function
n  next match
N  previous match
it/vim-cheatsheet.g 全部 i 忽略大小写 c 确认: g all, i ignore case, c confirm
it/vim-cheatsheet.:s/old/new/g 当前行全部\n:%s/old/new/g 全文件\:
:s/old/new/g  whole current line
:%s/old/new/g  whole file
:%s/old/new/gc  whole file with confirmation
:5,10s/old/new/g  lines 5-10
it/vim-cheatsheet.删字符/删行/复制行: Delete a character / delete a line / copy a line
it/vim-cheatsheet.x 删字符\ndd 删整行\nyy 复制整行\n3dd 删 3 行\n3:
x  delete a character
dd  delete the line
yy  copy the line
3dd  delete 3 lines
3yy  copy 3 lines
it/vim-cheatsheet.p 光标后粘贴\nP 光标前粘贴:
p  paste after the cursor
P  paste before the cursor
it/vim-cheatsheet.dw 删到下个单词\nde 删到单词末尾\nd$ 删到行末\ndd 删行:
dw  delete to the next word
de  delete to the end of the word
d$  delete to the end of the line
dd  delete the line
dG  delete to the end of the file
it/vim-cheatsheet.cw 改单词\nc$ 改到行末\ncc 改整行:
cw  change a word
c$  change to the end of the line
cc  change the whole line
it/vim-cheatsheet.yw 复制单词\ny$ 复制到行末\nyG 复制到文件末:
yw  copy a word
y$  copy to the end of the line
yG  copy to the end of the file
it/vim-cheatsheet.>G 缩进到文件末\n>> 缩进当前行\n<V 块选后取消缩进:
>G  indent to the end of the file
>>  indent the current line
<V  unindent the selected block
it/vim-cheatsheet.:set number -- 显示行号\n:set nonumber\n:se:
:set number  -- show line numbers
:set nonumber
:set tabstop=4
:set expandtab
:set autoindent
:set hlsearch  -- highlight searches
:set ignorecase  -- ignore case
:set paste  -- paste mode
it/vim-cheatsheet.:split 水平分割\n:vsplit 垂直分割\nCtrl+w w 切:
:split  horizontal split
:vsplit  vertical split
Ctrl+w w  switch window
:q  close the current window
it/vim-cheatsheet.:tabnew\n:tabnext 下个标签\n:tabprev 上个标签\:
:tabnew
:tabnext  next tab
:tabprev  previous tab
gt  next tab
gT  previous tab
it/vim-cheatsheet.\"ayy -- 复制行到寄存器 a\n\"ap -- 粘贴寄存器 a\n\:
"ayy  -- copy the line to register a
"ap  -- paste register a
"+y  -- copy to the system clipboard
"+p  -- paste from the system clipboard
it/vim-cheatsheet.ma 设置标记 a\n`a 跳到标记 a\n'a 跳到标记行首:
ma  set mark a
`a  jump to mark a
'a  jump to the start of the marked line
it/vim-cheatsheet.gd -- 跳到光标下变量定义: gd  -- jump to the definition of the variable under the cursor
it/vim-cheatsheet.Ctrl+o 跳回上个位置\nCtrl+i 跳到下个位置:
Ctrl+o  jump back to the previous position
Ctrl+i  jump to the next position

it/emacs-cheatsheet.emacs file.txt\nemacs -nw file.txt -- 终:
emacs file.txt
emacs -nw file.txt  -- terminal mode
emacsclient -t file.txt  -- connect to the daemon
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x 表示同时按 Ctrl 和 x: C-x means holding Ctrl and pressing x
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-x 指令名 -- 执行指令\nM-x compile -- 编译\nM-:
M-x command  -- run a command
M-x compile  -- compile
M-x shell  -- open a shell
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x C-s -- 保存当前文件: C-x C-s  -- save the current file
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x s -- 询问保存每个缓冲: C-x s  -- ask about saving each buffer
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-n 下一行\nC-p 上一行:
C-n  next line
C-p  previous line
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-a 行首\nC-e 行末:
C-a  line start
C-e  line end
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-f 下个单词\nM-b 上个单词:
M-f  next word
M-b  previous word
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-a 句首\nM-e 句末:
M-a  sentence start
M-e  sentence end
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-< 文件首\nM-> 文件末:
M-<  start of file
M->  end of file
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-v 下一页\nM-v 上一页:
C-v  next page
M-v  previous page
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-l 光标行居中\nC-u 0 C-l 行到顶部\nC-u - C-l:
C-l  center the cursor line
C-u 0 C-l  line to the top
C-u - C-l  line to the bottom
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x u -- 撤销\nC-/ -- 撤销\nC-g C-/ -- 重做:
C-x u  -- undo
C-/  -- undo
C-g C-/  -- redo
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-SPC -- 设标记\n移动光标选区\nM-w -- 复制选区\nC-w:
C-SPC  -- set the mark
move the cursor to select
M-w  -- copy the region
C-w  -- cut the region
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-w 剪切选区\nM-w 复制选区\nC-y 粘贴:
C-w  cut the region
M-w  copy the region
C-y  paste
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-y 选择历史: M-y cycle through the kill history
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-y -- 粘贴\nM-y -- 替换为更早的剪贴内容:
C-y  -- paste
M-y  -- replace with an earlier kill
it/emacs-cheatsheet.删到行末: Delete to the end of the line
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-k -- 删除光标到行末\n连续按删除多行:
C-k  -- delete from the cursor to the end of the line
press repeatedly to delete several lines
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-d 删下个单词\nM-Backspace 删上个单词:
M-d  delete the next word
M-Backspace  delete the previous word
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-s word 向下搜\nC-r word 向上搜\n多次 C-s 下一个:
C-s word  search forward
C-r word  search backward
press C-s again for the next match
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-% foo RET bar\ny 替换\nn 跳过\n! 全部替换:
M-% foo RET bar
y replace
n skip
! replace all
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x b -- 切换缓冲\nC-x b *scratch* -- 切到 s:
C-x b  -- switch buffer
C-x b *scratch*  -- switch to scratch
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x C-b -- 打开缓冲列表: C-x C-b  -- open the buffer list
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x k -- 关闭当前缓冲: C-x k  -- kill the current buffer
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x 0 关闭当前窗口\nC-x 1 只保留当前\nC-x 2 水平分割:
C-x 0  close the current window
C-x 1  keep only the current one
C-x 2  split horizontally
C-x 3  split vertically
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-x 5 2 新 frame\nC-x 5 0 关闭 frame:
C-x 5 2  new frame
C-x 5 0  close the frame
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-x shell -- 打开 shell 缓冲: M-x shell  -- open a shell buffer
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-x compile -- 输入 make 命令: M-x compile  -- type the make command
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-x grep -- 输入 grep 命令: M-x grep  -- type a grep command
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-x magit-status -- 打开 Git 界面: M-x magit-status  -- open the Git interface
it/emacs-cheatsheet.C-h k C-s -- 查看 C-s 的绑定: C-h k C-s  -- show the binding of C-s
it/emacs-cheatsheet.M-x customize -- 打开配置界面: M-x customize  -- open the configuration UI
